aiDecisionGuidancePublish.sourceStatus: game/security: one bullet under server authority (server-invoked AI decisions are not authority; player-authored input carries client-input trust; irreversible outcomes via server rules and human review; default behavior for delay, failure and rate limiting), basis TypeSafe jev-1.13 jaggedness and JevOut arXiv 2609.30243. security/overview: prompts keep pasted secrets in plaintext session history, so analysis copies and external model/classifier inputs need local deterministic masking first and raw text is not sent out for secret judgment. tools/builtin: long normal work runs to completion without progress chatter; elapsed time never decides failure; short timeouts with same-condition retries are prohibited and any limit is only an outer safety bound; scripts log state/progress periodically and poll the real condition; unchanged values are only a stall candidate that starts diagnosis (process liveness, CPU/disk output, log tail, waited condition) while the work keeps running, and stopping requires confirmed failure or impossibility evidence (two same-day corrections: user rejected timeout-first wording, review rejected stopping on unchanged values). workflow: changed checkers/runners/conditions get one run with a deliberately broken input to prove they fail (failure-confirmation test), and reported artifact paths are checked for existence and content before being written. Vendor prices, limits and accuracy deliberately not recorded
